disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensed or registered electrologist to comply with the requirements of this chapter or the applicable regulations adopted by the Board.

(c) A valid electrologist's license issued by a state whose licensing requirements are equal to or greater than those of this State. (d) Either training or practice, or a combination of training and practice, in electrology outside this State for a period specified by regulations of the Board.
